[[File:Abeloth_EGTW.jpg|thumb|Abeloth, the ancient being who is extensively shown in the Histories.]]
{{Quote|Our work.|[[Thuruht Queen]]|<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
'''''The Histories of Thuruht''''' were a group of stone carvings in the [[Thuruht]] [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive, the oldest of the hives which was employed by the ancient and mysterious [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial's]] to build mechanical wonders like [[Centerpoint Station]] and [[Sinkhole Station]]. Each described some rare occurrence of nature in the past or present, along with the origins of the dark side entity [[Abeloth]].

==List of Galactic Carvings==
*A [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] exploding in one direction.
*The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] being aligned in the same pattern and cycling around in the same orbit.
*A [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] hanging between two star systems like a curtain.
*A star system with the planets very close in orbit and two twin planets completely in synchronization.

==List of Carvings regarding the Celestials==
*[[The Ones/Legends|The Ones]] rising from a volcanic mist and gaining their Celestial power with the [[Son/Legends|Son]] drinking from the [[Font of Power]] and the [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]] swimming in [[Pool of Knowledge|The Well of Knowledge]].
*A carving of the Father, Son and Daughter living in harmony.
*The Son and Daughter fighting over the planet.
*A Mortal Woman serving [[The Ones/Legends|The Ones]] and bringing joy to them.
*Various reliefs showing the Mother playing with the son and daughter, living with the father, and helping channel the son's destructive energies.
*The Ones living a content life as a true family
*The Mother aging and the Father, Son and Daughter having a heated argument.
*The Mother drinking from the Font of Power to become as immortal as her family.
*The Mother swimming in the Well of Knowledge, becoming Abeloth, as the Father pulls her out with [[The Force/Legends|the force]]. The Daughter restraining the Son as he tries to come to his Mother's aid.
*A Fully transformed Abeloth being showed out by the Father.
*The Father, Son and Daughter leaving Abeloth alone, imprisoned on the world.
*The first time Abeloth was freed.
*Various carvings depicting saurians battling Abeloth and her cephalopods.
*3 worlds completely razed by Abeloth's destructive fury.
*The Killiks using the force in space to build Centerpoint Station.
*The Brother and Sister coming together in their insect forms overseeing the construction, the Brother; a beetle and the Sister: a graceful butterfly.
